headline: 157 dead, 403 missing as flash floods and landslides hit Nepal
summary: The disaster is being called the worst natural calamity in Nepal since the 2015 earthquake, with hundreds of foreign tourists missing.
details: At least 157 people have been killed and 403 others remain missing following devastating flash floods and landslides across Nepal.
A significant number of the missing are foreign tourists, with 341 foreigners including 133 Indians, 47 Americans, and 33 British citizens among those unaccounted for.

The disaster has caused severe infrastructure damage, with Nepal's electricity authority reporting a loss of approximately 430 megawatts of production capacity from hydroelectric and solar power plants.
Experts and officials describe this event as the most severe natural disaster to strike the country since the the deadly 2015 earthquake.
Bangladesh has expressed its grief and solidarity with the people of Nepal and has offered assistance to help the country recover from the tragedy.
caption:
157 dead and over 400 missing in Nepal's worst natural disaster since 2015.

At least 157 people have been killed and 403 others remain missing following devastating flash floods and landslides across Nepal.

A significant number of the missing are foreign tourists, with 341 foreigners including 133 Indians, 47 Americans, and 33 British citizens among those unaccounted for.

The disaster has caused severe infrastructure damage, with Nepal's electricity authority reporting a loss of approximately 430 megawatts of production capacity from hydroelectric and solar power plants.

Experts and officials describe this event as the most severe natural disaster to strike the country since the the deadly 2015 earthquake.

Bangladesh has expressed its grief and solidarity with the people of Nepal and has offered assistance to help the country recover from the tragedy.

headline_marked: Rumors of [[actor Elias Kanchan's death are false]], NISCHA protests
headline: Rumors of actor Elias Kanchan's death are false, NISCHA protests
summary: The road safety organization NISCHA clarifies that the actor and founder is alive and healthy in London, condemning the spread of misinformation on social media.
details: Actor Elias Kanchan and founder of the road safety movement 'Nirapod Sarak Chai' (NISCHA), is alive and healthy, contrary to rumors of his death circulating on social media.
The central leadership and members of NISCHA's 120 branches across the country have expressed strong condemnation and protest against the spread of these misleading reports.
NISCHA officials stated that Kanchan is currently receiving medical treatment in London and is doing well, but the rumors were spread without any verification from reliable sources.
NISCHA Secretary General Litton Ershad criticized the rush to publish news first, stating that the competition for speed should never replace truthful and responsible journalism.
The organization emphasized that declaring a living person dead is not only irresponsible but also an insult to the feelings of the person's family, colleagues, and fans.
NISCHA has called upon social media users to stop sharing unverified death reports and to confirm information from reliable sources before posting.
The organization has also demanded that the source of the rumor be identified and legal action be taken against those who intentionally spread false information to create panic.
NISCHA leaders have requested prayers from the public for Elias Kanchan's continued health, longevity, and a well-being.
caption:
Is Elias Kanchan dead? No. NISCHA has officially debunked the rumors and condemned the spread of misinformation.

Actor Elias Kanchan and founder of the road safety movement 'Nirapod Sarak Chai' (NISCHA), is alive and healthy, contrary to rumors of his death circulating on social media.

The central leadership and members of NISCHA's 120 branches across the country have expressed strong condemnation and protest against the spread of these misleading reports.

NISCHA officials stated that Kanchan is currently receiving medical treatment in London and is doing well, but the rumors were spread without any verification from reliable sources.

NISCHA Secretary General Litton Ershad criticized the rush to publish news first, stating that the competition for speed should never replace truthful and responsible journalism.

The organization emphasized that declaring a living person dead is not only irresponsible but also an insult to the feelings of the person's family, colleagues, and fans.

NISCHA has called upon social media users to stop sharing unverified death reports and to confirm information from reliable sources before posting.

The organization has also demanded that the source of the rumor be identified and legal action be taken against those who intentionally spread false information to create panic.

NISCHA leaders have requested prayers from the public for Elias Kanchan's continued health, longevity, and a well-being.

#EliasKanchan #NISCHA #Bangladesh #FakeNews #RoadSafety

Source: Jamuna TV
